ModMetaData.name: Hog Shuttle
ModMetaData.author: MagosZ
ModMetaData.description:
A small, boxy spacer shuttle built on Vehicle Framework and VTOL Vehicle.
THE SHUTTLE - Footprint 4×8 (the body is a box once its wings are out). - Crew: 1 pilot (required) and 1 co-pilot (optional). Passengers: 8. Cargo: about 1,000 kg. - Fuel: chemfuel. - No weapons yet.
FLIGHT - Hovers on the local map (VTOL): take off, fly, land, auto-land on a saved spot, board nearby colonists. - Flies across the world map like other Vehicle Framework aircraft. - With Odyssey: flies to space (gravships, orbital sites, asteroids) and back. - Sealed cabin: everything aboard, crew, passengers and cargo, stays at 21°C wherever the shuttle is, and pawns aboard take no vacuum (with Odyssey). Passengers still get hungry, heal and so on as in any Vehicle Framework vehicle, and food in the hold ages as in a 21°C room.
RESEARCH - "Hog shuttle" in the Vehicles research tab (Vanilla Vehicles Expanded). Needs aerial vehicles and, with Odyssey, shuttle. - Spacer tech, hi-tech research bench and multi-analyzer.
Placeholder art for now.
